boundaries: No original Lua files, complete recovered source, credentials, original videos, or game server state are published.
Predicate/API snapshots and adapter acknowledgments are explicit research inputs unless supplied by a verified web adapter. Unknowns never become successful steps by default.
SetTutorialFinished registration is distinct from visual FinishTutorial completion.
No arbitrary next-step event exists. Only registered source events, actual source mask callbacks, scheduled callbacks and lifecycle entry points execute.
External effects emit no rewards and mutate no main game board or wallet. Missing mutations block their source path.
Source pairs/listener race order is not inferred; individual guide instances may be coordinated externally.
Presentation targets retain source identities. Native geometry, text layout, audio and input timing need separate evidence.
EEventType and UIPrefabConfigName names are canonical source symbols, not observed native event IDs. TutorialDefinition enum values are copied only as bounded metadata.

adapterContract.tuples: Use {$luaTuple:[...]} only for an observed/specified Lua return tuple. Plain arrays remain one Lua table; unknown arity is not padded with invented nil.
adapterContract.closures: Pending and mask callbacks share serialized cells by ID. JSON round trips preserve aliasing. Resume reconstructs executers from source persistedData, discards transient cells/timers and does not replay Finished-registered tutorials.
adapterContract.constraints: constraintUpdates contains source global tutorial-model deltas; the parent coordinator applies them in a declared observation/web order. These updates are input requirements, never main-board or wallet mutations. Transient constraints reset on source resume.
adapterContract.effects: External effects contain source ID, category and typed argument availability. Required effects stop until a verified web adapter or explicitly labeled research acknowledgment exists. Do not automatically acknowledge all UI or all model calls.
adapterContract.events: EEventType/UIPrefabConfigName labels use canonical source symbols. Source mask callbacks remain callable until a new mask/hide/finish changes them; a callback returning early does not consume the mask.
